sentences.en: Rare gems include aquamarine, amethyst, emerald, quartz and ruby.
sentences.zh: 稀有的宝石包括海蓝宝石、紫水晶、祖母绿、石英和红宝石。

sentences.en: Rocks take time to decompose, especially quartz and feldspar.
sentences.zh: 岩石需要时间分解，尤其是石英和长石。

sentences.en: I have chunks of rose quartz in my bedroom.
sentences.zh: 我的卧室里有一些粉晶碎片。
